Conditional/unvalidated mechanisms can pass. Do not demand experiments, proof, implementation or guaranteed novelty. Unknown apparatus details do not alone make a hypothesis mathematically wrong. Do not rewrite or develop a new hypothesis. A plan/definition alone is not mechanism progress; describe it accurately. Use Chinese. Prior-work statuses: already_done/no_close_work_found/unclear. Coherence: no_obvious_error/obvious_error/unclear. No-close means this bounded search only. For each cited source give exact supporting quote from its text; do not cite invented sources. If no source directly supports already_done, use unclear. Historical reference date is strictly before 2024-09-12.
